name: PAIR Ops
description: PAIR API + web health, the launch pipeline (Added → Launch click, Launch click → Launch), Exa spend (ExaCall / ExaConfig / ExaPeopleFanout) and ingest. Source of truth: docs/observability/newrelic/pair-ops-dashboard.json.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND transactionType = 'Web' TIMESERIES
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND transactionType = 'Web' TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Latency p50 / p95 (s)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT LIKE '%search_jobdiva_candidates%' AND name NOT LIKE '%launch%' AND name NOT LIKE '%stream%' AND name NOT LIKE '%enrich%' TIMESERIES

widgets.description: Excludes the long-lived streaming endpoints (search, launch, enrich, streams).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*), average(duration), percentile(duration, 95), average(databaseDuration), average(databaseCallCount) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET name LIMIT 25
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND error.expected IS NOT true FACET error.class, transactionName LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*), percentile(duration, 95), max(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND transactionType = 'Other' FACET name LIMIT 30
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) FROM Metric WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND metricTimesliceName LIKE 'Custom/JobDiva/%/ms' FACET metricTimesliceName TIMESERIES LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM JobDivaAPI WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET endpoint, status_code TIMESERIES LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM JobDivaBiLimiter WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET outcome TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Added → Launch click (median hours)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT median(added_to_click_s) / 3600 AS 'hours' FROM PairJobFirstLaunch WHERE appName = {{api_app}} SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.description: T1 - T0: job added to PAIR until the recruiter's first Source & Launch click. One sample per job (PairJobFirstLaunch, sent when the job's first interview is created, from every launch path) — relaunches and sessions that launched nobody never add a sample.

widgets.title: Launch click → Launch (median minutes)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT median(click_to_launch_s) / 60 AS 'minutes' FROM PairJobFirstLaunch WHERE appName = {{api_app}} SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.description: T2 - T1: click until the job's first interview is created in Pairbot (sourcing + screening + launch). One sample per job (PairJobFirstLaunch); per-session speed, relaunches included, is the p50 / p90 tile.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM PairLaunchTiming WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET status SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT percentile(click_to_launch_s / 60, 50, 90) FROM PairLaunchTiming WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET relaunch TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Where the time goes (median seconds per stage)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT median(sourcing_s) AS 'sourcing', median(selection_s) AS 'selection', median(enrichment_s) AS 'enrichment', median(human_wait_s) AS 'waiting on recruiter', median(saving_s) AS 'saving', median(pairbot_s) AS 'pairbot creation' FROM PairLaunchTiming WHERE appName = {{api_app}} SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PairLaunchSession WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET stage, status TIMESERIES LIMIT 20
SELECT percentile(ms_in_stage / 1000, 50, 95), count(*) FROM PairLaunchSession WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET stage LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Resumed / retried sessions

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(session_id) FROM PairLaunchSession WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND (attempt > 0 OR claims > 1) FACET stage TIMESERIES

widgets.description: Sessions picked up again after a crash, deploy, worker recycle or a failed stage.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(ms, 50, 95), count(*), percentage(count(*), WHERE ok IS false) AS 'failed %' FROM PipelineStage WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET stage LIMIT 40
SELECT count(*) FROM PipelineStage WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND ok IS false FACET stage TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*), percentile(duration, 95) FROM PageView WHERE appName = {{web_app}} TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*), percentile(duration, 95) FROM BrowserInteraction WHERE appName = {{web_app}} FACET targetUrl LIMIT 15
SELECT count(*) FROM JavaScriptError WHERE appName = {{web_app}} FACET errorMessage LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Failed API calls from the browser (5xx / network)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM AjaxRequest WHERE appName = {{web_app}} AND (httpResponseCode >= 500 OR httpResponseCode = 0) FACET requestUrl LIMIT 15

widgets.title: API latency seen by the browser (p95 ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(timeToLoadEventStart * 1000, 95), count(*) FROM AjaxRequest WHERE appName = {{web_app}} FACET requestUrl LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE appName = {{web_app}} AND (actionName LIKE 'job_wizard_step5_%' OR actionName LIKE 'launch_%' OR actionName LIKE 'pair_launch_%') FACET actionName TIMESERIES LIMIT 15
SELECT count(*) FROM PageAction WHERE appName = {{web_app}} AND actionName = 'FrontendLog' FACET status, msg LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Exa spend by surface ($)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(cost_total) FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET surface TIMESERIES

widgets.description: Exa's own costDollars per call (an estimate; the invoice is per key). Search/contents calls carry no run id.

widgets.title: Spend and runs by surface / tier / trigger

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(cost_total) AS '$', count(*) AS 'events', uniqueCount(exa_run_id) AS 'agent runs' FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET surface, tier, trigger LIMIT 50
SELECT uniqueCount(exa_run_id) FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND endpoint = 'agent_run' FACET outcome TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Failures by surface / outcome

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND outcome NOT IN ('ok', 'completed') FACET surface, outcome, http_status LIMIT 30

widgets.description: out_of_credits / breaker_open = the account ran dry (alert: PAIR Exa credits exhausted).

widgets.title: Pass A: what one search call costs

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(cost_total) AS 'total $', average(cost_search) AS 'search $', average(cost_pages) AS 'contents $', average(cost_pages) / average(cost_total) * 100 AS 'contents %', average(num_results) AS 'asked', average(n_results) AS 'got', count(*) FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND endpoint IN ('search', 'contents') AND outcome = 'ok' FACET surface

widgets.description: cost_pages settles whether /search bills the contents of every result (docs/exa-cost-optimization.md).

widgets.title: $ per contact found (by tier and arm)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(cost_total) / filter(count(*), WHERE fields_found LIKE '%phone%') AS '$ per phone', sum(cost_total) / filter(count(*), WHERE fields_found LIKE '%email%') AS '$ per email', filter(count(*), WHERE outcome = 'completed') AS 'answered', sum(cost_total) AS '$' FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND surface = 'contact' AND endpoint = 'agent_run' FACET tier, arm, path

widgets.description: Late-watch events (late = true) carry the final cost and fields of runs we stopped waiting for.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 50, 95), count(*) FROM ExaCall WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND late IS NOT true FACET surface, tier LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Exa flags per worker (ExaConfig)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(pass_b), latest(deep_analysis), latest(metadata_on), latest(sdk_version), latest(breaker_ttl_s), latest(normal_effort), latest(deep_effort), latest(per_query_factor), latest(search_cache_ttl_s), latest(search_cache) FROM ExaConfig WHERE appName = {{api_app}} FACET worker_pid SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20

widgets.description: Sent by each worker at most hourly from a Step-5 search with Exa. pass_b / deep_analysis should be false; a true here is a hand-set .env override. search_cache should be on; off_config = REDIS_URL or ENCRYPTION_KEY missing on that worker.

widgets.title: Pass A search cache: hit rate

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(cache_hits) / (sum(cache_hits) + sum(cache_misses) + sum(inflight_joins)) AS 'hit rate', filter(count(*), WHERE cache_state != 'on') / count(*) AS 'cache not on' FROM ExaPeopleFanout WHERE appName = {{api_app}} TIMESERIES

widgets.description: One ExaPeopleFanout per Pass A / Dice search. Expected hit rate 0.40-0.65 once Exa has credits; 'cache not on' should be ~0 (FACET cache_state: off_config = config fault, down = Redis errors).

widgets.title: Pass A per-query sizing

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'fan-outs', sum(cost_usd) AS '$', average(cost_usd / cache_misses) AS '$ per paid query', percentage(count(*), WHERE starved IS true) AS 'starved %', percentage(count(*), WHERE cf15_same IS true) AS 'F=1.5 same %', average(deepest_rank) AS 'deepest rank', average(dup_rows) AS 'dups' FROM ExaPeopleFanout WHERE appName = {{api_app}} AND cache_misses > 0 AND failed = 0 AND abandoned IS NOT true FACET surface, queries, per_query LIMIT 20

widgets.description: Fan-outs that paid, lost no query (a failed query leaves the merge short for another reason) and were not abandoned (a closed Step-5 stream sends no rows or cost). starved should stay under 5% (raise EXA_PEOPLE_PER_QUERY_FACTOR if not); lower it to 1.5 when 'F=1.5 same %' is 95%+. '$ per paid query' by per_query answers how Exa bills contents past 10 results.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name = {{api_app}} AND message LIKE 'Exa%' AND level IN ('WARNING', 'ERROR', 'CRITICAL') FACET level, message LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name = {{api_app}} FACET level TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name = {{api_app}} AND level IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL') FACET message LIMIT 20

widgets.title: PAIR ingest by event type (GB, last day)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT bytecountestimate() / 1e9 FROM Transaction, TransactionError, Span, Log, PipelineStage, JobDivaAPI, JobDivaBiLimiter, PairLaunchSession, PairLaunchTiming, ExaCall, ExaConfig WHERE appName = {{api_app}} OR entity.name = {{api_app}} FACET eventType() SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.description: Estimate. The account free tier is 100 GB/month across Pairbot, Hoonr and PAIR.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(GigabytesIngested) FROM NrConsumption WHERE productLine = 'DataPlatform' FACET usageMetric SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
